A biography is a detailed chronicle of a person's life.

An autobiography is the detailed chronicle of a person's life, written by that person.

The word biography comes from the Greek words bio meaning "life" and graphia meaning "to write" or "written." In other words, a biography is a written account of a person's life. When it is your own life, you write an autobiography.

Many of the famous names you recognize have biographies written about their lives.
